_note: Board 302:1978 — the 580x520 S3.7 card on a gray-900 ground. Three boards
(SEO 302:1978, Social 302:2004, Advanced 302:2026) draw the SAME chassis, so
every chassis number here is agreed by three frames, not one.
WHAT MOVED:
· The header ✕ (2838:12107, 13px ink-muted) did not exist. The drawer's
own docblock said 'There is no ✕', which was true of an older capture;
all three 2026-09-07 boards draw one inside header frame 302:1980. Until
now a modal dialog's only exits were ESC and a scrim click, neither of
which is on screen. Placed at the card's top-right: Figma exports the
header as a flex COLUMN, so the generated code puts the glyph under the
tab row, which is an auto-layout artifact and not where a close lives.
· Field labels were BK_LABEL_CLASS (12px ink-soft); 302:1988 / 302:1992 /
302:1996 and their Social and Advanced siblings are 13/500 ink-muted.
BK_LABEL_CLASS is NOT moved — it is a chrome-wide primitive measured
against many other boards. The override is scoped to `.bd-pg-drawer-body
label`, two classes deep so it beats `tw:text-xs` on specificity rather
than on source order.
· Field COPY: 'Title' -> 'Meta title', 'Meta Description' -> 'Meta
description', 'URL Slug' -> 'URL slug' (302:1992 / 302:1996 / 302:1988).
Sentence case, and 'Meta title' is what the field actually is.
NEW EVIDENCE ON authority=open:input-fill (OPEN-DECISIONS §3). These three
boards draw the text input 42 TALL, radius 8, fill --color/bg-panel white,
padding 12/10 — which is BK_TEXT_INPUT_THEME exactly, on every number that
149:108 disputes. Recorded here because the dispute has been running on two
boards and now has three more on the theme's side. What is still NOT
measured is `border-color`: all four inputs on all three boards carry
--color/ink #111827 while the theme ships flowbite gray-300, and four
simultaneously-black borders cannot be a focus state. That is the same
chrome-wide control the open authority covers, so it is skipped, not passed.
NOT CONFORMED, and why:
· STRUCTURE. The board's SEO tab is four plain fields (URL slug / Meta
title / Meta description / Search indexing). The shipped tab is a Google
preview card, a score block with a four-check grid, a 'Reach 80+' banner
and three fields. Conforming literally would DELETE the score system —
behaviour, not visuals — and 'Search indexing' lives on the Advanced tab
(allowIndex). Fields are joined by IDENTITY here, not by position.
· The 2838:121xx layer. 'btn/Done' is drawn white-on-white with an
--color/error BORDER and --color/error-text label; on the Advanced board
the same batch draws seg/will-publish in that treatment and seg/draft,
seg/hidden, seg/password in solid accent — three simultaneously-active
segments. No shipped control combines those tokens and no segmented
control has three active segments, so this reads as a designer's markup
layer (red = gap, filled = proposal) rather than as UI. The same batch
carries the UX-B-10 / UX-B-19 / UX-B-22 annotation paragraphs, which
LEDGER J-164:22 already ruled are annotations. Reported, not built.
THE TEXT INPUTS ARE SKIPPED, NOT PASSED. They are joined to no board node
because border-color is board-vs-board: 149:108 draws --color/border-input,
these three draw --color/ink #111827 on all four instances, and two boards
that disagree do not re-settle a chrome-wide primitive
(authority=open:input-fill, OPEN-DECISIONS §3). Measured anyway, from
measured/<surface>.json, because the numbers are the useful part: the
shipped control is 42 tall on a radius-8 white fill — which is what these
boards draw and what 149:108 disputes. Padding is the one real difference
(theme 10, board 12) and it belongs to the same open call.
